subject: PO / invoice cadence: aligning PO arrival windows with invoice recognition
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acmedata.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO / invoice cadence: aligning PO arrival windows with invoice recognition

Hi Acme procurement team,

Quick note as we approach SOW sign-off: to avoid revenue hold during recognition we want to align the PO arrival and invoice routing so AP can accept invoices within the right billing window. Can you confirm the expected PO number generation date and whether you can provide the PO to us at least 3 business days before the planned invoice date?

Specifically:
- Do you issue a single PO per quarter or per engagement?
- Can invoices be routed to ap@acmedata.com and copy procurement@acmedata.com?
- Do you need any particular invoice reference fields (SOW number, project code) to accept invoices without further PO follow-up?

I'm cc'ing Laura and Ben so we can update the forecast and mark the booking commit once PO timing is confirmed. If it'd help, we can provide a short check-list for AP to validate invoices on receipt.

Thanks — hope we can lock timelines this week.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_Acme_v3.docx (draft)
From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmedata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO / invoice cadence: aligning PO arrival windows with invoice recognition

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear ask. We typically issue a single PO per engagement and will generate PO_789 once the SOW is fully executed. Target timeline from our side:
- SOW executed (DocuSign): Sep 12
- PO generated and sent: Sep 14 (we can prioritize earlier if needed)
- AP processes invoice within 5 business days of receipt

We can send the PO PDF to ap@acmedata.com and copy procurement@acmedata.com. Please include SOW number and Redwood invoice reference in the invoice footer (SOW-ACME-789).

Attaching the PO stub so your billing team can pre-populate fields. Let us know if the 2-day lead time is sufficient for your recognition window.

Regards,
Ayesha Khan
Procurement Lead | Acme Data Inc.
procurement@acmedata.com

Attachments: Acme_PO_789.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acmedata.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@acmedata.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO / invoice cadence: aligning PO arrival windows with invoice recognition

Thanks Ayesha — that timeline works but a couple quick asks to make sure AR/finance can close the loop: 

1) Can you confirm the exact file name and PO number when you send (please use Acme_PO_789.pdf in the subject so finance matches automatically).
2) We'll send the final invoice once PO is received; can AP accept invoices with SOW-ACME-789 in the reference field (this avoids manual holds)?
3) Please share the DocuSign link for the SOW once countersigned so we can attach it to the invoice packet.

I've attached a short billing-provisioning-checklist.xlsx that documents the fields our accounting system uses — if you can populate these ahead of invoice, it will speed processing and avoid revenue deferments.

Once we have PO file + DocuSign SOW, we'll move the opportunity to Commit and add the recognition date to next week's forecast.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Best,
Jonas

Attachments: billing-provisioning-checklist.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PO / invoice cadence: aligning PO arrival windows with invoice recognition

Forwarding Acme's note for visibility. Quick internal ask:

- Jonas: when you receive the final PO and DocuSign SOW, please update the HubSpot deal to Stage=Commit and add anticipated invoice date (Sep 14) to the bookings recognition field.
- Ben: please queue the ticket to Billing Ops to expect Acme_PO_789.pdf and to pre-validate the SOW reference.
- Marissa: can you confirm whether we need to run a quick revenue-quality eval on the SOW language (any customer-favorable credit terms) before we mark for recognition?

If everyone agrees, I'll sign-off and we can flag this for next Tuesday's commit review.

Thanks — small operational items but those are what keep recognition clean.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
